trust_center.repositoryDescription: Silkline's FedRAMP Trust Center holds the FedRAMP 20x Class C program and its control implementations. The landing page and these documents are public: the Secure Configuration Guide, Acceptable Use Policy (Rules of Behavior), Code of Conduct, Information Security Policy (Program Umbrella), Privacy and Personal Information Management Policy, Vulnerability Disclosure Policy. The Gated Trust Center Deliverables entry in this overview lists the documents shared on request.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Open the URL without signing in to read the program and download public documents. To read a gated document, select Request Access. Silkline reviews each request and grants access to federal agencies, prospective federal customers, their assessors, and FedRAMP reviewers. Send questions about access to fedramp@silkline.ai.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Customer administrator guidance for secure access, roles, sharing, integrations, notifications, exports, and provisioning defaults.
secure_configuration_guidance.accessRequestInstructions: Open the guide URL without signing in. A Markdown version is available at https://docs.silkline.ai/configuration/secure-configuration-guide.md, and its secure defaults as JSON at https://app.silkline.ai/.well-known/fedramp/secure-configuration-guide. Apply the administrator checklist during onboarding, administrative access changes, and periodic reviews. Compare actual settings with the recommended configuration, record exceptions, and contact support@silkline.ai for setup or recovery assistance.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Drive procurement straight from your BOM and always know your clear-to-build date. Includes Demand, Parts Library, Categories, and Auto-categorization. Security category: Moderate (FedRAMP Class C).

Send and track RFQs, securely share part files, and compare quotes. Includes Requests, BOM & CSV Import, RFQs, Quotes, and Quote Comparison & Split Awards. Suppliers respond to RFQs in the Supplier Portal. Security category: Moderate (FedRAMP Class C).

Automate PO generation and approvals. Includes Orders, Automated PO Creation, Supplier Defaults, Bulk Line Items, Order Activity Feed, Send Purchase Orders, Order Sync from ERP/MES, Approvals, Approvals Dashboard, Taxes, Budgets, Shop, Integrations, Integration Sync Health, and GraphQL API. In FedRAMP-enabled organizations: Shop runs only in the Silkline desktop app. Shopping in a cloud-hosted browser, saved supplier sign-in, and refilling a cart from a past order are unavailable. Email to suppliers, including purchase orders and issues, cannot carry PDF or file attachments. The Quantum and HRIS integrations are unavailable. Security category: Moderate (FedRAMP Class C).

Capture PO confirmations, manage open orders, and prevent disruptions. Includes Order Confirmations, Order Tracking, Order Workflows, Receipts, Line Items, Check-ins, Home Dashboard, Search & Data Console, and Email Integration. Suppliers view and confirm orders in the Supplier Portal. Security category: Moderate (FedRAMP Class C).

Continuously monitor supplier scorecards and documentation. Includes Supplier Directory, Approved Supplier List, Supplier Document Tracking, Supplier Scorecards, Insights, and Supplier Onboarding & Evaluations. In FedRAMP-enabled organizations: Supplier and contact enrichment from third-party data is off. Security category: Moderate (FedRAMP Class C).

Automate procurement documentation for FAR/DFARS and ISO/AS9100. Includes Secure File Sharing, Custom File Storage, Terms & Conditions, Role-Based Access Control, Pedigree & Traceability, Quality Clauses, Non-Conformance & Issues, and Single Sign-On (SSO). In FedRAMP-enabled organizations: Links that open without sign-in (Anyone with link) are unavailable; every recipient signs in. Custom File Storage is unavailable. Security category: Moderate (FedRAMP Class C).

certified.useCase: AWS GovCloud (US) hosts the offering and provides managed services, including Amazon SES delivery of system-generated email and Amazon Bedrock inference. Bedrock serves only Anthropic Claude and OpenAI gpt-oss models that AWS lists as FedRAMP Class D in AWS GovCloud (US) at https://aws.amazon.com/compliance/services-in-scope/FedRAMP/amazon-bedrock-models/, and the Bedrock endpoint policy denies every other model.
Datadog for Government (US1-FED) provides observability, security monitoring, incident investigation, and audit evidence.
Paramify Cloud holds Silkline's FedRAMP 20x package, evidence, and Trust Center.
Keeper Security Government Cloud stores staff credentials, occasionally including credentials a customer supplies, and provides the one-time codes and passkeys staff use to sign in.

current.service_desc: Silkline is a supply chain and procurement platform that enables collaboration on quotes, orders, parts management, and production workflows. Every certified service is in the FedRAMP offering, and each one names the capabilities FedRAMP-enabled organizations do not get. All services share Tags, Configurable Fields, Custom Branding, Multi-Currency, Custom Email Domain, and Activity Feed & Collaboration.
